description: Create a new category or a category group. Set is_group=true to create a category group; supply children as an array of existing category IDs, existing category objects, and/or strings (names of new sub-categories to create).

archived.description: Whether the category should be archived.

children.description: Only valid when is_group is true. Array of existing category IDs (numbers), existing category objects (their id is used), and/or names of new sub-categories to create (strings). Categories must already exist and cannot be category groups; ones already in another group are moved.

collapsed.description: If true, the category group appears collapsed in the Lunch Money app. Can only be true for category groups (requires is_group=true). Usually managed by the user in the app.

description.description: Optional description. Up to 200 characters. Null is the same as omitting it.

exclude_from_budget.description: Whether transactions in this category should be excluded from budgets.

exclude_from_totals.description: Whether transactions in this category should be excluded from calculated totals.

group_id.description: If set, assigns the new category to an existing category group. Cannot be set if is_group is true. Null is the same as omitting it.

is_group.description: If true, creates a category group instead of a category. When true, group_id may not be set; use children to assign existing categories.

is_income.description: Whether transactions in this category should be treated as income.

name.description: Name of the category. 1-100 characters. Must not match an existing category or category group name.

order.description: Position of the category on the categories page in the Lunch Money app. For categories in a group, the position is relative to the other categories in that group. Usually managed by the user in the app.

name: create_category
